```yaml
name: Update Roadmap Documentation

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
    paths:
      - 'docs/roadmap.md'

jobs:
  update-roadmap:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        
      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'
          
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install markdown-tables
          
      - name: Generate roadmap content
        id: generate_content
        run: |
          # Create the new roadmap content
          NEW_CONTENT=$(cat << 'EOF'
## Document Understanding Tasks
| Task | Description | Priority |
|------|-------------|----------|
| Table structure recognition | Detect and extract structured tables from documents | High |
| Key-value extraction | Extract key-value pairs from forms and documents | High |
| Reading order | Determine logical reading sequence of text elements | Medium |
| Handwriting | Recognize handwritten text in documents | Medium |
| Scene text | Extract text from natural scenes and images | Low |
| Document classification | Classify documents into categories | High |
| Multi-page context | Understand relationships across multiple pages | High |
| Figure/chart awareness | Recognize and interpret figures and charts | Medium |

## Data Augmentation (SynthDoG)
| Task | Description | Priority |
|------|-------------|----------|
| Realistic noise | Add realistic noise patterns to synthetic data | Medium |
| Complex layouts | Generate documents with complex layouts | High |

## Modeling Additions
| Task | Description | Priority |
|------|-------------|----------|
| Quantization recipes | Provide quantization recipes for deployment | High |
| Confidence estimation | Add confidence scoring for predictions | High |
| Serving example | Include serving examples for models | Medium |
| ONNX/TRT export | Support ONNX and TensorRT exports | High |
| Data mixing strategy | Implement data mixing strategies | Medium |
| Experiment tracking | Add experiment tracking capabilities | Medium |

## Benchmarking Additions
| Task | Description | Priority |
|------|-------------|----------|
| Robustness benchmarks | Test model robustness under various conditions | High |
| Commercial API comparison | Compare against commercial APIs | High |
| Cross-dataset generalization | Test generalization across datasets | High |
| CI regression testing | Add regression tests to CI pipeline | High |
| Failure mode taxonomy | Document common failure modes | Medium |
| Domain-specific benchmarks | Create domain-specific benchmarks | Medium |

## Developer Experience
| Task | Description | Priority |
|------|-------------|----------|
| Unified CLI | Provide unified command-line interface | High |
| Tutorials | Create comprehensive tutorials | High |
| Model cards | Generate model cards for each component | Medium |
| Output format interop | Ensure compatibility with various output formats | Medium |
EOF
)
          
          echo "content<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "$NEW_CONTENT" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          
      - name: Update roadmap file
        run: |
          # Read existing roadmap content
          EXISTING_CONTENT=$(cat docs/roadmap.md)
          
          # Create new content with separator
          NEW_ROADMAP=$(echo "$EXISTING_CONTENT" | head -n -1)
          NEW_ROADMAP="$NEW_ROADMAP\n\n---\n\n"
          NEW_ROADMAP="$NEW_ROADMAP$CONTENT"
          
          # Write back to file
          echo "$NEW_ROADMAP" > docs/roadmap.md
          
      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add docs/roadmap.md
          git commit -m "docs: update roadmap with new tasks, benchmarking, and DX" || echo "No changes to commit"
          
      - name: Push changes
        uses: ad-m/github-push-action@master
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: ${{ github.ref }}
```
